item.title: Strengthening Trust and Credibility in the Direct Selling Channel: The Importance of Industry Self-Regulation - Direct Selling Education Foundation
item.description: This article explores the value of industry-led self-regulation as a tool for promoting business accountability, protecting consumers, and strengthening public trust. In the direct selling sector, the Direct Selling Self-Regulatory Council exemplifies this commitment, working independently, but alongside companies, trade associations, and compliance professionals to uphold ethical standards and proactively address emerging challenges.
